scope: Default-off actual adaptive linear OUT replay. Generated component centers are based on independent original CPU dot endpoints, including deliberately selected midpoints; this checks kernel and consumer behavior, not the accuracy of the matrix producer envelope for arbitrary data. The unchanged original GPU residual/normalization consumer compares all residual and normalized F32/BF16 bits against independent CPU original updates. Nonfinite normalization forces bounded full replay; deliberately invalid centers require observed-boundary failure and complete original selected replay. The certificate depends on the existing empirical producer PPB/midpoint envelope. An observed violation disables certification and finishes all selected cells, but unobserved interval undercoverage is not proven impossible. Real-model GB10 gates and product timing remain separate. Host fault injection checks the real allocation/transport/drain owner, not GPU arithmetic.
